buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Shelf Life: The Product/Spare parts to be supplied as part of the services must have minimum 5 Yrs Shelf Life. On the date of supply, minimum 5 Yrs usable shelf life should be available / balance. 3. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of IGP, RAJASTHAN SECTOR, CRPF NAYLA, JAIPUR payable at STATE BANK OF INDIA, NAYLA, JAIPUR RAJASTHA N A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. Sample Clause

After award of contract – Successful Bidder shall have to get advance sample approved from buyer before bulk manufacturing / starting bulk supplies. Successful Bidder shall submit 02 samples for Buyer's approval, within 15 days of award of contract. Buyer shall, as per contract specifications framework, either approve the advance sample or will provide complete list of modification required in the sample within 15 days of receipt of advance sample. Seller shall be required to ensure supply as per approved sample with modifications as communicated by Buyer. If there is delay from buyer side in approval of advance sample – the delivery period shall be refixed without LD for the period of delay in sample approval. In case, the sample is found to have major deviations / not conforming to the Contract specifications, the buyer at its discretion may call for fresh samples for approval before allowing bulk supplies or may terminate the contract after notifying the deviations to the seller. Unless otherwise provided in the contract, all samples required for test shall be supplied by the contractor free of cost. Where under the contract, the contractor is required to submit an advance sample, any expenses incurred by the contractor on or in connection with the production of stores in bulk, before the sample has been approved unconditionally shall be borne by the Seller and he shall not claim any compensation in the event of such sample being found unacceptable by the Buyer / Consignee. 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 8. i) EMD exemption will be applicable only for OEMs of offer product. 1. ii) Bidder should submit EMD Rs. 3,91,507/- which remain valid for 180 days from the bid opening date, scan copy of EMD should be submitted with bid and original EMD should be submitted within 07 days of opening date of bid failing which offer is liable to be rejected/ignored. (EMD) iii) Failure to submit EMD will be treated as incomplete bid and may lead rejection of the bid. EMD of the unsu ccessful firms shall be returned after finalization of bid. vii) Bidders who are quoting brand of OEMs will mandatory required to submit the E MD as Udyam/MSE exemption will not applicable for such bidders. viii) If authorized dealer and OEM both participated in the bid(same) then agent/auth orized dealer will be disqualified. (Para 5.14(VIII) – MoPG-2022) iv) If bidder quotes his own manufactured brand and he is also manufacturer as per Udyam certificate, or his firm is GeM VA verified for Suitcase with Trolley, then E MD is exempted. 2. Lab test reports: - Latest lab test report as per bid confirming specification shall be submitte d from the testing agency/Lab i.e. CIPET/MSME Mumbai/NTH/MSME Meerut of date after publishing of BID/floating tender otherwise participated firm is liable to be rejected. 3. Compliance with specification:- Firms must submit details of specific model compliance with specification of Suitcase with Trolley as per QRs/Specification approved by MHA vide letter No. U.II -98(Spec)/2023-24-Prov-(Suitcase)-14 dated 01/11/2023. 4. Offer Product catalogue required to be submitted with Bid documents . 5. Mandatory In-House Manufacturing & Testing Facilities: - The OEM must possess comple te in-house manufacturing and testing facilities required for the production of suitcases. Outsourced or partially outsourced manufacturing processes shall not be permitted. 6. Production Capacity Certification/vendor assessment certificate: Mandatory submission of OEM's Production capability certificate/Vendor assessment certificate for bid item issued by des ignated agencies CIPET/ MSME Meerut/MSME Mumbai/NTH. Details of the machines/ test equipment mandatory to be available in OEM's Production Plant (own manufacturing unit):- a). Injection Moulding Machine (for injecting Poly Propylene) (Minimum capacity 900 tons). b). Multi-layer sheet extrusion machine, c). CNC trimming machine, d). Assembly line set up (869 Stitching machine, High lead machine etc.) e). Wheel testing Machine, f). Jerk testing machine. g). Tumble testing machine, h). Drop test machine, i). Zipper testing machine, j). Trolley testing machine etc. (i) Provide documents on capacity of Poly propylene (PP) Injection Molding Machine (These are big size luggage hence the shells need to be molded on machine capacity of 900 Ton or more). (ii) Test certificate, undertaking and invoices related to specified Raw Materials (as per QRS) Virgi n Poly propylene etc to achieve consistent quality to track lot. (iii). Documents related to 100% inspection of luggage at the end of the assembly line. Capacity Verification report/certificate of the OEM to be submitted by the firm along wi th bid document issued by either of the designated agencies CIPET/MSME Meerut/MSM E Mumbai/NTH.

7. Firms must submit OEM's Factory Licence issued by State Govt. 8. Firms must submit OEM's Pollution Control certificate issued by State Pollution Control Board. 9. Compliance with Quality and Environmental Standards: - The OEM must comply with the following additional regulatory requirements (Docs/Cert. to be uploaded along with bid docs): A. ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management System) B. ISO 14001: 2015 (Environmental Management System). 10. Report of Anti-theft Zipper with relevant test certificate. 11. Quality Assurance :- (a) Manufacturers/Contractors must satisfy themselves first by carrying out thorough pre-inspecti on of each lot/ batch that the stores manufactured are in accordance with the contract and fully co nform to the specification, before offering stores for PDI (Pre-dispatch inspection). (b) It is mandatory of the manufacturers to give Certificate of Conformity from respective OEM's o f the raw materials, wherever desired from CIPET/ MSME, Mumbai/NTH/MSME Meerut used in the c onstruction of the Suitcase with trolley Cases. (c) A declaration by the Contractor that necessary pre-inspection/tests have been carried out on t he stores tendered and the same are fit for inspection. 12. Marking. (a) In addition to marking of CRPF Logo using indelible ink on the fabric in the inner side of the sui tcase, A Taffeta Label with following markings is required to be stitched at one corner of the Briefc ase with trolley on the inner side seams using indelible ink/embroidery: * Marking as per Latest IS standards (IS 15809:2017) * Month and Year of manufacture * Manufacturers name/Trade name/Regd. Trade Mark * Wash/Drying/Usage care instruction (Pictograms would not permitted) 13. Packing: * Suitcase packed in transparent polybag - 50 micron. * Separator Flap 3 ply in between two suitcase -to avoid scratches in transport. * 5 Ply cartons for multiple packing of suitcase. * Printed tape for box packing - 60 mm. * Following material shall be used for packing of Suitcase with trolley. 14. Method Of Packing: - The Suitcase shall be delivered / packed in new, dry, clean and sound condition. a) Two suitcases separately packed in Non-Woven Bag shall form 1 Unit Pack (carton), which shall further be wrapped by HDPE bag and securely stitched with not less than 6 stitches per 10 cm and then strip bound with two band of polypropylene strapping across width and one across lengt h. Each Polypropylene straps shall be of one complete piece and the ends shall be heat-sealed wit h machine. 15. Marking of Package: - Before dispatch, each package shall be legibly/ indelibly marked/ prin ted in black showing the following details:- (a) Nomenclature and Cat No. of store. (b) Quantity packed in the bale. (c) Lot No. and Date (d) Month and year of packing (e) Name and trade mark of manufacturer (f) Gross mass of bale in kg. (g) S.0/Extract No. and Date. (h) Inspection Note No. and Date. (j) Serial No. of the package. (k) Name & Address of the consignee. 16. Joint PDI shall be done with CRPF BOO and representative of CIPET/MSME Meerut/MSME Mum bai/NTH. oard of officers (B.O.O) from the bulk store randomly. All these samples should conform to the app roved samples in respect of the indeterminable parameters such as shade, feel, finish and workma nship. After that B.O.O. of CRPF will send specific number of randomly chosen sample (as approve d) of Suitcase with Trolley from reference sample to (CIPET/MSME MEERUT/MSME MUMBAI/NTH) . If the tested sample fully meets t he governing specification/QRs, the reference sample shall be approved by the board of Inspecting officers duly signed and sealed and then it should be sent to the consignees. Past Performance/Experience Criteria- CAPFS / KPKB, Armed Forces/Any Govt Organization for suitcase/Hard shell luggage, Rucksacks, etc. Bidder should have regularly manufactured and suppli ed same or similar Category Products i.e Suitcase with Trolley for 03 years before the bid opening date. In this regard bidder should submit copies of at least 02 successfully completed orders of supplying Suitcase with Trolley to any Central/State Govt. Organization /PSU / Public listed Company. In each order the quanti ty supplied should be 10% (591 Nos.) of bid quantity 18. Brand of product:- Bidders must participate for Registered Brand on GeM. Documents in con nection with Trademark of same brand required to be submitted with bid documents failing which bid shall be rejected at initial stage. Bid for unbranded/unregistered brand shall be liable to be ignored/rejected. 19. A bidder may be considered to have a conflict of interest with one or more parties in this bidding process if; a. They have controlling partner (s) in common; or b. Termination of contract: Time shall be the essence of the contract. The Purchaser shall have the rig ht to terminate this contract without any notice in part or in full in any of the following cases :- i) The delivery of the material is delayed for causes not attributable to Force Majeure by more than 90 day s after the scheduled date of delivery. ii) The seller is declared bankrupt or become insolvent. iii) In case performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) is not furnished within 15 days from the date of issue of co ntract (supply order). 26. Force Majeure Clause: If at any time, during the continuance of this contract, the performance in wh ole or in part by either party of any obligation under this contract shall be prevented or delayed by reason of any war, hostility, acts of public enemy, civil commotion, sabotage, fires, floods, explosions, epidemics, quarantine restrictions, strikes, lockout or act of God (hereinafter referred to “event”) provided, notice of t he happening of any such even in given by either party to the other within 21 days from the date of occurr

ence thereof, neither party shall be reason of such event, be entitled to terminate this contract nor shall either party have any claims for damages against the other in respect of such non-performance or delay in performance, and deliveries under the contract. The contract shall be resumed as soon as practicable after such even has come to an end or ceased to exist, and the decision of the Purchaser as to whether the deliv eries have been so resumed or not, shall be final and conclusive, Provided further that, if the performance in whole or part or any event for a period exceeding 60 days, either party may at its option terminate the c ontract provided also that if the contract is terminated under this clause, the purchaser shall be at liberty t o take over from the contractor at a price to be fixed by the purchaser, which shall be final, all unused, un damaged and acceptable materials, bought out components and stores in course of manufacturer in the p ossession of the contractor at the time of such termination or such portion thereof as the purchaser may d eem fit excepting such materials, bought out components and stores as the contractor may with the concu rrence of the purchaser elect to retain. 27. Liquidated Damages: - In case firm does not complete the supply within fixed Delivery Period, L/D wi ll be imposed/recovered a sum equivalent to 0.5 (Half)% of the delivered price (including GST, freight and other charges) of the delayed Goods/Stores for each week of delay or part thereof until actual delivery of p erformance, subject to a maximum deduction of the 5% of total contract value. In case of inordinate delay (i.e. inexcusable delay of more than on- fourth (25%) of the total completion period shall be treated as inor dinate delay) and maximum deduction shall be 10% of the total contract value. After which purchaser res erves the right to either extend further or cancel the contract as per Para 9.3.9 of Manual for Procurement of Goods, Second Edition-2024. 28.
